- Use glossary terms exactly: Pulse (not Survey), Person (not User), Round (not instance), Submission (not Response). Do not drift to the "avoid" synonyms.

- Issues and specs live in GitHub issues (`gh`); conventions are in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`. Commit subjects name the release slice, e.g. `R1 03: ...`.
- Privacy invariants are release blockers (SPEC §7): anonymous Submissions store no Person and no time (ADR 0005), comments are redacted at store time (ADR 0009), and every shown aggregate obeys the minimum group size (ADR 0004).

## Commands (from the repo root)

Node 24 (`.node-version`) and pnpm 12.18.0 are pinned.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck          # tsc -b with project references
pnpm typecheck:effect   # @effect/tsgo diagnostics; CI runs this first
pnpm lint               # oxlint --type-aware
pnpm format             # oxfmt; CI runs format:check
pnpm test               # Vitest "unit" project only
pnpm test:privacy       # Vitest "privacy" project only; NOT part of pnpm test
pnpm test <path>        # one file, e.g. pnpm test packages/domain/src/people/SignIn.test.ts
pnpm --filter @surveybeat/web build
```

CI runs `typecheck:effect`, `typecheck`, `format:check`, `lint`, `test`, then the web build; the privacy suite is a separate required job. Exercise sign-in and end-to-end flows on a deployed stage.

## Layout and boundaries

- `packages/domain` — Effect schemas and services by concept (`people/`, `email/`); depends only on `effect`.
- `packages/api` — the `HttpApi` declaration shared by the Worker and the typed web client; depends on `domain`.
- `packages/cloudflare` — all Cloudflare adapters plus the `MainWorker` and `SubmissionWorker` entries; the only package that touches the Alchemy runtime.
- `apps/web` — one Vite project with two entries: the Foldkit app (`index.html`) and the plain-TypeScript answer page (`answer.html`).
- `packages/emails` — React Email templates and rendering. `packages/testing` — privacy harness. `infra` — Alchemy stack, scripts, Playwright e2e, privacy sweep. `tools/oxlint-plugin-surveybeat` — local lint rules.

- Effect is 4.1.2, not 3.x. Import from `effect/Effect`, `effect/Schema`, `effect/http-api`, `effect/http/...`; there is no `@effect/platform` v3-style API here. Copy the import style from neighboring files.

- Stricter than defaults: `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `verbatimModuleSyntax` (use `import type`), and relative imports carry explicit `.ts`/`.tsx` extensions.

## Tests

- Tests are colocated `*.test.ts`. A privacy test must be named `*.privacy.test.ts` or CI never runs it.
- Use `@effect/vitest` (`it.effect` for Effect programs).
- Adapter tests use `@alchemy.run/test`'s `Test.make({ dev: true })` against local workerd and are slow (deploy timeouts up to 240 s); run the single file you need.
- A new API endpoint must be classified in `packages/api/src/PrivacyRegistry.ts` or the package will not typecheck; `registry.privacy.test.ts` checks the runtime declaration too.
- End-to-end tests run only against a deployed stage: `E2E_BASE_URL=https://pr-<n>.app.surveybeat.app pnpm test:e2e` (install Chromium once with `pnpm --filter @surveybeat/infra exec playwright install chromium`).

## Infra

- Every Cloudflare resource is declared in `infra/alchemy.run.ts`; no dashboard edits, no wrangler config.
- Run Alchemy from the repo root: the Organization DO migrations path (`packages/cloudflare/migrations`) is relative to the working directory. Build the web app first; the Main Worker serves `apps/web/dist`.
- `pnpm infra:deploy --stage dev-<name>` needs `WORKOS_API_KEY` and `WORKOS_CLIENT_ID` in the environment. Who may create an Organization is `infra/org-creation-allowlist.yaml`, per stage.
- Non-production stages never send real email; sends are recorded in D1's `captured_email`. Only `production` sends.
- The Submission Worker must keep every observability channel off. `pnpm check:observability --stage <stage>` reads the deployed settings back; the canary sweep proves no logs are kept. Stage scripts need `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`.
- New SQL migrations: numbered files in `packages/cloudflare/migrations` (Durable Object) or `packages/cloudflare/d1-migrations` (D1).

- [Cloudflare cf CLI](cloudflare-cf-cli.md) — authenticated cf CLI for SurveyBeat's Cloudflare account; discover commands with cf cli search
- [Wayfinder: always push and merge](wayfinder-always-push-merge.md) — push and squash-merge each resolved ticket's branch without asking
- [Merge own PRs](merge-own-prs.md) — squash-merge my green PRs in surveybeat-next without asking

# A member's history page reads past answers only from their own browser

The member's private history page lists the Rounds the member took part in, from their Participation records, which the server already holds with a Person and no answers (ADR 0005). Their own past answers come only from their own browser: when the answer page saves a Submission, it also keeps the member's answers in local storage next to the Edit key, for one year, and the member can clear them. For each Round the page shows the member's own answer beside the Team's score, but only once the Result is shared and the aggregate meets the minimum group size.

The server never learns which Submission is the member's. A new device or cleared browser data shows the Rounds without answers, and the page says why.

## Considered options

- **Server-side history encrypted with a key only the member holds:** rejected for Release 2. Key recovery across devices is hard to get right, and any server-side record of a member's answers, encrypted or not, weakens the A1–A10 invariants (ADR 0005) that the privacy suite proves.
- **Only the Team's Results the member took part in, no own answers:** too little to be worth a page.

## Consequences

- Answers stay on one device. The page must state this plainly.
- Comments are kept in the browser as the member typed them, not redacted; they never leave the device.
- Clearing site data or a private window loses the history. Nothing on the server can restore it.

## Scoping report for issue #108 (items 2–7)

**This task is complex.** It touches more than one subsystem (answer page, Organization DO, API, privacy registry, web app). It adds a new authenticated endpoint that returns Result-derived data, so it is a published API change. Its privacy tests and minimum-group-size rules are release blockers. The parent should check the brief closely, and should read `Organization.ts` around `viewResults` and `SqlRounds.ts` `recordFirstAnswer` directly.

### 2. Participation records (Organization DO)

- Table `participation (round_id, person_id)`, WITHOUT ROWID, PK (round_id, person_id). Created in `packages/cloudflare/migrations/0007_invitations.sql` (last block). The `submission` table has no person column (`0008_submissions.sql`).
- Written in `recordFirstAnswer`, inside the transaction, at `packages/cloudflare/src/SqlRounds.ts:637`. Insert happens after the `hasAnswered` check at `:631`.
- `recordParticipation` is defined at `SqlRounds.ts:589` (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). I did not confirm whether anything calls it.
- Existing readers: `hasAnswered` (`SqlRounds.ts:569-574`, per Round and Person); `deleteParticipationForPerson` (`:586`). `round_member` (`0006_rounds.sql`, index `round_member_by_person`) holds eligibility, not participation.
- **No query lists Rounds for a Person.** A new query would join `participation` to `round` (columns: `pulse_name`, `planned_open_date`, `status`, `team_id`, `pulse_id`). It would go in `SqlRounds.ts`, be exposed via `Organization.ts` (the DO method block near `:1834-1880`), and be called from a handler.
- `packages/cloudflare/src/SubmissionWorker.privacy.test.ts:64` and `Submissions.privacy.test.ts:208` already assert the participation rows; reuse those patterns.

### 3. Results sharing and N-gated aggregates

- A Round is Shared when `round.status = 'shared'`. Set by `markRoundReadyAndShared` (`SqlRounds.ts:336-340`), called from the compute path in `Organization.ts:810-857`. The Result is stored in `round_result` (`0009_results.sql`), read by `getRoundResult` (`SqlRounds.ts:842`).
- Per-Round team scores come from `calculateRoundResult` (`packages/domain/src/rounds/Results.ts:345`). It returns `RoundResult` (`Results.ts:126-147`), which has `questions: QuestionResult[]` (`:80-94`, with `score`, `distribution`, `contributors`, `meetsMinimumGroupSize`) and `dimensions: DimensionResult[]` (`:97-113`, `score`, `contributors`, `meetsMinimumGroupSize`).
- The N gate is `enforceEffectiveNOnResult(result, currentOrgN)` (`Results.ts:956`). The effective N is `max(storedN, orgN)`. `Organization.ts:~1476` applies it on read and strips comments for non-Leads (`:1480-1486`).
- Read path: `viewResults` in `Organization.ts` (about `:1395-1490`). It authorizes with `authorizeRoundAction`, then returns the stored or computed Result.
- Team-wide shared Results: `getSharedRoundResultsForTeam` (`SqlRounds.ts:852-858`, `status = 'shared'`, ordered by `planned_open_at`). Team health: `buildTeamOverview` (`packages/domain/src/rounds/TeamOverview.ts:62-111`). Its per-Dimension gated point is `pointScore` (`TeamOverview.ts:50-55`).
- The "PastRounds" logic is `getPastRoundsResultsForPulse` (`SqlRounds.ts:952-980`, last 12 Rounds).

### 4. API and privacy registry

- No `/me` endpoint. The Person id comes from `auth.session` (`packages/api/src/index.ts`, AuthApiGroup at `:66-92`; `PrivacyRegistry.ts:94-96`).
- Closest shape for "list my Rounds": `rounds.listRounds` (`index.ts:285`, `/teams/:teamId/pulses/:pulseId/rounds`, `RoundList`, `roundErrors` at `:265`). A caller-scoped no-param shape is `directory.listTeams` (`index.ts:132`). Groups use `HttpApiGroup.make(...).add(...).prefix("/api")`.
- Registry: `packages/api/src/PrivacyRegistry.ts`. Each key is `group.endpoint` with `{ _tag: "NoResultData", why }` or `{ _tag: "ResultData", inputs }`. Result-bearing endpoints need an `inputs` generator (`roundResultScenarios`, `:74`).
- `packages/api/src/registry.privacy.test.ts`: `resultResponders` (`:201-204`) must have one entry per `ResultData` key (check at `:50-57`). A history endpoint that returns Team scores must be `ResultData`, with a responder that checks no score below N (use `violations`/`overviewViolations`, `:255`, `:284`).
- Handlers: `packages/cloudflare/src/RoundHandlers.ts` (`HttpApiBuilder.group(SurveyBeatApi, "rounds", ...)`, pattern at `:30-37`, `:126-132`). Wired in `MainWorker.ts:250-258`.

### 5. Web app

- Routes: `apps/web/src/app/routes.ts`. `AppRoute` union at `:15-25`. Each route has a router (`:28-63`), an `appRouter` `oneOf` list (`:65-74`), and an href helper (`:77-85`). A new `History: {}` route needs an entry in all three.
- App shell: `apps/web/src/app/App.ts`. Messages and Commands: `GetTeamOverviewCmd` (`:387-394`). Route-driven init: `:887`. `GotTeamOverview` case: `:2028`. View: `teamOverviewView` at `:2326`. Model fields such as `teamOverview: { _tag: "Loading" }` (`:814`, `:953`).
- Page pattern to copy: `apps/web/src/app/overview.ts`. It uses `defineTaggedUnion` (`LoadedOverview`, `:10-14`), `Failure` from `api.ts`, and `message()`. `api.ts` builds an `HttpApiClient` (`:1-5`).
- Scene tests: `apps/web/src/app/App.scene.test.ts` (1326 lines), using `foldkit/scene` and `foldkit/test/vitest`. `App.story.test.ts` exists too.
- Messages: `apps/web/src/messages/` contains `catalog.ts`, `index.ts`, `messages.test.ts`. **There is no `de.ts`.** New copy goes into `catalog.ts`. Plurals use `.one`/`.other`.
- Nav: I did not confirm where the nav links are rendered. Assumption: they are in `App.ts`'s view, near `:2326`.

### 6. Answer-page tests and budget

- `apps/web/src/answer/budget.test.ts` (checks `apps/web/dist/answer.html`, builds if missing):
  - HTML ≤ 8 KB raw and gzip (`:23-30`)
  - inline `<style>` ≤ 2 KB gzip (`:32-40`)
  - critical-path JS ≤ 10 KB gzip, including `messages-*.js` (`:42-70`)
- `apps/web/src/answer/round-context.test.ts`: `parseRoundContext` and `anonymityStatement` tests, with a `roundContext()` fixture (`:5-15`).
- Storage and expiry logic for the answer page has no test yet. A pure helper module under `apps/web/src/answer/` would fit the existing unit-test style.
- Current sizes are not measured. `apps/web/dist/answer.html` did not exist when I checked.

### 7. Handler wiring and test files to copy

- `packages/cloudflare/src/TeamOverviewApi.test.ts`: `SignInWorld` and `Browser` from `auth/testing.ts`. Sets up an Organization, a Team, a Lead, and members. Tests status codes per role (`:1-45`). Copy this for the history endpoint's authorization tests.
- Other handler tests: `PulsesApi.test.ts`, `ActionsApi.test.ts`, `DirectoryApi.test.ts`.
- Result-level tests: `ResultsStorage.test.ts`, `PastRounds.test.ts`, `SubmissionRoundContext.test.ts`.

### Things the parent should decide or check

1. **An existing server path already returns a member's answers from an edit key.** `POST /my-answers` (`packages/cloudflare/src/SubmissionWorker.ts:247-280`, `Organization.ts:1878`, `SqlRounds.ts:703`) returns the answers for an edit key. I found no caller in `apps/` or `packages/`. ADR 0017 says the server should not hold the member's answers in a way it can link. Decide whether this endpoint is reused, removed, or left alone.
2. The new endpoint must not return the Submission id or any answer. It should only return Round metadata plus Team Results gated by N. Decide whether Team scores come from `viewResults` (per Round) or from `getSharedRoundResultsForTeam`.
3. Authorization after leaving a Team: a Person's old `participation` row survives Membership end. Decide whether history shows Rounds from ended Memberships.
4. The `/auth/session` response is the only source of the caller's Person id. The new endpoint should use `currentMember` like the other handlers.

### Possible split (facts only)

- **Slice A, answer page (no server dependency):** `apps/web/src/answer/main.ts` (`doFirstSave` `:243-279`, `saveAnswer` `:536-549`), plus a new helper module and unit test. Also the budget check in `budget.test.ts`.
- **Slice B, server (depends on nothing):** `packages/api/src/index.ts`, `PrivacyRegistry.ts`, `registry.privacy.test.ts`, `RoundHandlers.ts`, `SqlRounds.ts`, `Organization.ts`, a new `*Api.test.ts`, and the privacy test.
- **Slice C, web page (depends on B's endpoint schema, and on A for the stored-answers helper):** `routes.ts`, `App.ts`, a new page module, `messages/catalog.ts`, scene tests.

Slices B and C share the endpoint schema in `packages/api`. The domain query and response shape must land before C.
